thought.title: DORA Mandates Robust Cybersecurity and ICT Risk Management
thought.summary_short: The Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) imposes stringent requirements on financial entities for managing ICT risks and ensuring operational resilience. Firms must implement comprehensive frameworks for cybersecurity, incident reporting, and third-party risk management to avoid significant penalties.

It mandates a holistic approach to managing ICT risks, encompassing everything from cybersecurity defenses and incident management to business continuity and third-party risk oversight. Financial institutions will need to establish robust governance structures, conduct regular threat-led penetration testing, and ensure transparent reporting of ICT-related incidents. The regulation also extends to critical third-party ICT service providers, requiring them to adhere to similar resilience standards. Proactive implementation and continuous monitoring of these requirements will be crucial for compliance and for safeguarding against operational disruptions.
